Riley (Support): Heads-up: SolarWave onboarding stalled. Two failures during initial ingestion: API key provisioning returns 403 for a subset of tenant requests and search returns sparse results because embeddings were uploaded with the wrong dimensionality. Customer doing final validation prior to prod cutover. Renewal ~48 days. Can CS take this as P0? INC-5417
Sana (CSM): Acknowledged. Which environments are impacted? Need short customer-facing impact and timeline to add to account health doc.
Riley (Support): Sandbox and pre-prod mirrored config. Error snippets: `provisioner: access_denied scope=tenant_write status=403` and embed pipeline: `dim_mismatch expected=512 got=384`. Looks like an older embed client used by their partner integrator.
Marco (CS Ops): We'll split streams: auth/provisioning owned by Eng, ingest/reindex owned by CS Ops. I can prep a conversion/re-embed job and estimate window.
Sana (CSM): @Jun can Eng run a tenant-level API key sanity check and force-refresh provisioning caches? We need a stopgap and a rollback if patch affects other tenants.
Jun (Eng): Quick triage: provisioning service is rejecting keys with a specific scope name due to a recent policy change; some partner keys were minted with legacy scope. Mitigation options: 1) temporarily accept legacy scope for that tenant (ops toggle) or 2) re-issue keys with corrected scope. I'll run a scoped ops command to re-issue keys and add a guard to avoid broad exposure. Hotfix ETA ~1-2h. Longer-term config validation rule will be added.
Riley (Support): INC-5417 updated with sanitized logs and sample payloads. ticket-bot: status -> escalated to CS + Eng.
Sana (CSM): Draft customer note: "Hi Dana  We detected two problems during your sandbox ingest: (1) API key provisioning errors impacting some integration flows; (2) an embeddings schema mismatch causing incomplete search results. Immediate steps: re-issue keys for your tenant and run a mapping + re-embed job. We expect key fix within 2h and a reindex plan within 8 hours. Request 30m sync in next 45 minutes." Thoughts?
Priya (Renewals): Flagging account health: risk -> Elevated until reindex completes. Please include this summary in renewal tracker.
Marco (CS Ops): Re-embed workaround: use our migration tool `embed-migrate --from=legacy-0.8 --to=current --batch=600`. Estimated backfill: 4-6h for their dataset. I'll build a one-click run and coordinate a maintenance window overnight.
Jun (Eng): Ops command to re-issue keys for tenant `solarwave`: `POST https://internal.redwood/api/tenants/solarwave/keys/reissue -H "Authorization: Bearer <ops>" -d '{"scope":"tenant_write"}'`. Will run now for the tenant and monitor logs.
Sana (CSM): Internal comms plan bullets:
- Immediate: Re-issue tenant keys (Eng)  owner: Jun  ETA: 0-2h
- Short-term: Patch provisioning policy validation (Eng infra)  owner: Eng  ETA: 4-6h
- Reindex: Migration + re-embed job (CS Ops)  owner: Marco  ETA: 4-8h (can run overnight)
- Customer sync: 30m within 45m  owner: Sana
Sana (CSM): I'll schedule the 30m sync at 09:40am PT and send the note. @Riley attach sanitized logs and Marco share the migration job link once ready.
Riley (Support): Logs and failing request IDs attached. :white_check_mark:
ticket-bot: INC-5417 comment added: "Escalated CS + Eng; suspected provisioning policy + embed schema mismatch. Artifacts attached."
Priya (Renewals): Added a short line to renewal tracker and flagged AE to loop in if needed.
Jun (Eng): Running key re-issue now for tenant `solarwave`. Posting status in ~12m. :rocket:
Marco (CS Ops): Building migration script + runbook, will post artifact link in this thread.
Sana (CSM): Thanks team. I'll lead customer comms and weekly follow-ups until resolved. Ping me for any regression or if the customer requests a temporary rollback option.
